description:
Are you active Duty or a Veteran looking to buy a home? #homebuying
Do you think credit challenges are holding you back from homeownership? Don’t count yourself out just yet!

Hi, I’m Rachel Leslie — and I’ve helped service members and veterans overcome obstacles and find homes that work for them. 🏡

Even if you’ve been told “no” before… let’s talk. You might have more options than you think.

📲 Give me a call — I’m here to help you take the next step.
💬 Let’s see what’s possible!

Rachel Leslie, Realtor® 
📱254.226.5889
📩 Rachel@i35group.com 

#RachelLeslieRealtor #VAHomeLoan #VeteranHomeBuyer #ActiveDutyRealEstate #MilitaryRealtor #HomeBuyingHelp #CreditChallenges #DontGiveUp #CentralTexasHomes #i35Group #RealEstateSupport #HomeOwnershipJourney #VeteranStrong
